entity.name: Roshan Singh
entity.description: Go systems engineer working on DNS, network security and observability tooling. Maintainer of HydraDNS; upstream contributor to CNCF Jaeger.

projects.name: HydraDNS
projects.description: Network-wide DNS filtering rebuilt in Go: a gRPC control/data plane split, a web dashboard, DoH-bypass blocking, and a built-in Model Context Protocol server exposing 14 tools so an AI agent can manage the DNS firewall directly. Self-hosted and GPL-3.0.

channels.description: Direct bank transfer to an Indian account (INR). Details shared on request.

plans.name: Security hardening and pre-1.0 stabilisation
plans.description: Dedicated engineering time to take HydraDNS from a working pre-1.0 tool to something a cautious operator can run on a home or small-office network: hardening the resolver path, expanding test coverage, a security review of the gRPC control plane, and documentation.
